mechanism: Tetrabenazine undergoes hepatic metabolism via CYP2D6 and CYP3A4; berberine inhibits CYP3A4 and may inhibit CYP2D6, potentially increasing tetrabenazine exposure and adverse effects including QT prolongation and hypotension.
action: Monitor for increased tetrabenazine adverse effects (hypotension, sedation, QT prolongation); consider ECG monitoring and dose adjustment if berberine is co-administered.
